Class VillagerTradeProviderBase

java.lang.Object
org.moddingx.libx.datagen.provider.RegistryProviderBase
org.moddingx.libx.datagen.provider.sandbox.VillagerTradeProviderBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
RegistryProvider
public abstract class VillagerTradeProviderBase extends RegistryProviderBase
SandBox provider for villager trades. A villager trade describes a single offer: what the merchant wants and what it gives in return. Trades are grouped into trade sets through tags, see TradeSetProviderBase. This provider must run in the registry setup stage.
